description: Wait for a resume generation job to complete, then return the signed PDF download URL. Call after klevercv_generate_resume. Blocks until complete or timeout. Provide save_path to download the PDF to disk automatically. Errors: GENERATION_TIMEOUT, GENERATION_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_API_KEY.

save_path.description: Absolute or relative path to save the PDF locally, e.g. /Users/me/resume.pdf. If omitted, returns the download URL instead.

timeout_seconds.description: Max wait time in seconds. Default: 120.

name: klevercv_get_generation_status
